text_block_list.text: Some time passed—

—The season turns once again to autumn of 
crimson leaves. Kyoto Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Under clear skies here at Kyoto 
Racecourse! Today's main race is the Queen 
Elizabeth II Cup!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Above all else, the one drawing the most 
attention is none other than—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Challenging for a three-peat, huh... That 
truly is uncharted territory.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
So you are truly... taking on this 
monumental feat.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Running in this race is... something I 
decided on since last year."
choice_data_list:
Wasn't that a promise with Still in Love 
and the others?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. It's a promise of a rematch.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: And one more thing.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
So that I may continue to be your 
"greatest goal."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: A three-peat—I will definitely achieve it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...I will show them. A run that will not 
waver in the slightest, even with glory 
right before my eyes."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Finally you show up! Do your best out 
there, okay?! If you win, I'll celebrate 
with you again!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Mother. Please do not get carried away.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I will do my utmost.

The hurdle for this great achievement is 
monumentally high. The younger generation 
is gaining strength as well.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —Yes. I'm heading out.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
There you are, Admire Groove! No matter 
what it takes, I'm winning this year!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
—I've come to fulfill our promise. Today, 
I'm going to run alongside you with 
everything I've got.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (So many... formidable rivals.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (Duramente-san... She and her rivals are—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(I will likely wage an uncompromising 
battle against opponents whose values are 
completely different from mine. Even so—)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: We—will not lose.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(Sensei, Air Groove-san, myself, and 
Duramente-san. I will win decisively and 
carry on the torch...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —Now, let us begin.
